identity: The Moonfall Observatory charts the stars over a wood that someone is quietly emptying with marked snares.

quests.title: Howling Under the Eaves
quests.text: Briarpack Wolves run the {name:eaves} {zone_area:eaves}, mostly after dark, and their howling spoils my measurements. Defeat five of them. They call the pack when hurt, so fight with open ground behind you.

quests.title: Snares Between the Sighting Posts
quests.text: Unlicensed Poachers slip through the {name:eaves} at night and string snares between my sighting posts. Stop four of them. Their snares carry a warden's mark, and no warden of ours gave it.

quests.title: Bears Before Breakfast
quests.text: Bramble Bears guard the {name:deepwood} {zone_area:deepwood} by day and do not share their berries. Drive off five so my apprentices can collect lens-moss again. A bear is patient; be more patient.

quests.title: A Mote for the Great Lens
quests.text: The Wandering Wisps of the {name:wisp_fen} {zone_area:wisp_fen} glow brightly enough at night to blind a telescope. Bring me one Bound Wisp Mote and I will calibrate the great lens with it. The wisps drift only after dark.

quests.title: Posts the Poachers Broke
quests.text: The poachers kicked over three of my sighting posts to hang their snares. Bring me ten planks of any wood and I will raise them again before the next clear night. Saw them wherever you like; the stars are not in a hurry.

quests.title: The Snarewarden
quests.text: {name:snarewarden_bracken} puts the warden's mark on every snare in this wood and waits {dir_from_giver:snarewarden_bracken}, day and night. Defeat him and the marks mean nothing again. Vetch and Rusk answered to him; now he can answer to you.

quests.title: Optional: Pinchers on the Moonstrand
quests.text: Barnacle Pinchers crowd the {name:moonstrand} {dir_from_giver:moonstrand} by day, right where I set up to watch the moon rise over the water. Defeat five of them. Leave the Bank Crabs; they at least keep quiet.

quests.title: Optional: The Warden's Bears
quests.text: The snare marks lead into the {name:elderwood} {zone_area:elderwood}, where Bramble Bears stand guard by day. Clear six of them so the way to the one behind the marks stays open. They are old and very large; so is the problem.

quests.title: Optional: Webs over the Elderwood
quests.text: At night, Briar-Web Spiders hang their webs across the {name:elderwood}, and the snare-setters use them as markers. Kill six. Their silk is worth keeping; my lenses are not worth covering.

quests.title: Bounty: Webs in the Deepwood
quests.text: Briar-Web Spiders rebuild their webs in the {name:deepwood} every night. Kill six whenever you can, and the Observatory will pay each time.
